NativeSlideMechanics.Scope: Dry-road native Rigidbody/tire/drivetrain simulation; actual production input response at 60 Hz and physics at 360 Hz. Entry speed targets are not maintained slide speeds. Virtual driver feedback is test-only, not automatic player steering. Strict cases require physical entry, continuous controlled sliding, powered rear slip, actual countersteering and recovery without reset. All strict cases observed a three-second hold; acceptance threshold is one second. Wet drift and human driving feel remain unverified.

HeadlessPlayerCheck.Limitation: Null-device shader support diagnostics are expected in a no-graphics run. This does not verify rendering, startup visuals, F2 key interaction or subjective human driving feel.

ArchitectureLimitations: Engine RPM/launch remain algebraic; engine inertia and engine/transmission clutch dynamics are not integrated.
No physically simulated clutch-kick, stall, shift duration or shaft compliance.
AWD has equal center torque distribution, not a center differential model.
Tire relaxation, temperature, wear, pressure and measured-data calibration remain deferred.
Rolling-resistance/contact-reaction energy balance needs separate calibration.
No added yaw, automatic steering, grip override, brake-to-drift or maintained-speed drift force.
